text: Authenticated onboarding drafts are currently read from and written to browser localStorage rather than durable per-user Supabase state.
Grocery list history currently uses a global browser localStorage key rather than per-user Supabase persistence.
Day, workout, body, and grocery stores have module-level initialization state that is not keyed to the authenticated user, creating same-tab account-switch isolation risk.
Social OAuth currently starts through Supabase inside the WKWebView and the native shell has no ASWebAuthenticationSession flow.
The shipping iOS app currently has no declared deep-link or universal-link route for authentication callbacks.
Restaurant geolocation is used by the web app while the iOS Info.plist lacks NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription.
The current web logo source is a stacked 691x591 lockup forced into horizontal slots, producing illegible branding.
App Store candidate screenshots and their candidate-bound manifest are not present.

Authenticated preferences, units, goals, onboarding drafts, grocery history, and Coach mutations are server-authoritative and guarded against cross-account late responses in the repository implementation.

The repository iOS shell exact-binds trusted web and OAuth origins, contains redirect paths, declares auth callbacks and associated domains, and passes 14 focused iPhone 16e routing and release-manifest tests.
FuelWell release branding uses corrected horizontal lockups, launch assets, and a validated social card across web and iOS source surfaces.

source: npm run test:unit; npm run lint; npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build; npm run test:mobile:bounded
text: The local release candidate passes 455 unit tests, ESLint, TypeScript, production generation of 805 pages, git diff validation, and 38 bounded mobile checks across Chromium and WebKit at 320, 375, 390, and 430 pixels.

Live production acceptance remains pending because the Supabase migration, OAuth provider redirects, Coach provider configuration, and public AASA route have not yet been applied and verified on one immutable deployment.
